```yaml
      maxTokens: 200

    - id: weekly

      intervalSeconds: 604800

    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"

      group_counts: "{{ count_by_groupTypes.output }}"
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest managed devices by model and compliance state.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with compliance and sync information.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count by compliance state
    detail: Counts devices per compliance state using predefined buckets.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_managed_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort by last sync
    detail: Orders devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and keeps the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_managed_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize results
    detail: Generates a short report of the oldest devices and compliance counts.
    settings:
      system: You are a Microsoft 365 admin assistant. Provide concise, actionable insights.
      prompt: |
        Here are the oldest managed devices:
        {{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}

        And the compliance counts:
        {{ count_by_compliance.output }}

        Write a brief report highlighting any noncompliant models and recommending next steps.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      oldest_devices: "{{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
      compliance_counts: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
```
